description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Order made under Revenue Protection Act to demand and Levy on rice import duty w.e.f. 07.01.2017
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of a Revenue Protection Order under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962. It involves the Minister of Finance exercising statutory powers to set import duty rates on specific goods (rice), which constitutes a regulatory action. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters (customs duties and tariff changes) rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
